en_title: K/DA Reactivates Social Accounts, Fueling Rumors of the Virtual K-pop Group’s Comeback After 6 Years
cn_title: K/DA账号时隔六年更新，疑将回归
subtitle: 粉色火焰点燃猜想
opus_summary: K/DA官方账号时隔六年更新头像与横幅，加入粉色火焰并清空旧帖，引发回归猜测。此前数据挖掘还发现疑似新皮肤及新歌登记信息，Riot尚未确认回归或成员阵容。

paragraphs.en: Official K/DA accounts have been updated for the first time in six years. New profile and banner images continue to show the existing promotional art from the All Out era, now with the addition of hot pink flames. The reactivated accounts have also wiped existing posts, fueling rumors that the virtual girl group is gearing up for a comeback.
paragraphs.cn: K/DA官方账号时隔六年首次更新。新的头像和横幅仍沿用《All Out》时期的宣传图，但加入了亮粉色火焰。重新启用的账号还清空了旧帖，让这个虚拟女团准备回归的传闻愈演愈烈。

paragraphs.en: K/DA, which debuted at the 2018 League of Legends World Championship, consists of four League champions (Ahri, Akali, Evelynn, and Kai'Sa) voiced by international pop-stars. The group’s first single, aptly called POP/STARS, was the first K-pop song by a girl group to receive RIAA Platinum certification in 2022. The early success of the girl group prompted the release of a full EP, All Out, in 2020.
paragraphs.cn: K/DA在2018年《英雄联盟》全球总决赛上出道，由阿狸、阿卡丽、伊芙琳和卡莎四位游戏英雄组成，并由国际流行歌手献声。组合首支单曲《POP/STARS》可谓名副其实，于2022年成为首支获得美国唱片业协会（RIAA）白金认证的K-pop女团歌曲。凭借出道初期的成功，组合于2020年推出了完整EP《All Out》。

paragraphs.en: Since then, the group has pretty much gone dark. K/DA skins still exist in-game, but there’s been no word on new music or performances. Until now.
paragraphs.cn: 此后，这个组合基本销声匿迹。游戏里依然有K/DA皮肤，但新歌或演出一直没有消息。直到现在。

paragraphs.en: I’m not asking for much. I just want to see a teaser from K/DA that’s as peak as this. https://t.co/gWU9yf04w9
paragraphs.cn: 我的要求不高。我只想看到一支和这段一样顶尖的K/DA预告。https://t.co/gWU9yf04w9

paragraphs.en: An updated banner image continues to use promotional images from the All Out era, showing the main K/DA quartet alongside the era’s guest artist, Seraphine, who was a newly released champion at the time. As of October 13, however, those images also show the addition of hot pink and magenta flames .
paragraphs.cn: 更新后的横幅仍沿用《All Out》时期的宣传图，画面中除了K/DA四位成员，还有当时的客邀艺人萨勒芬妮——她在那个时期还是刚推出的新英雄。不过，截至10月13日，这些图片中还多出了亮粉色和洋红色火焰。

paragraphs.en: Data-mined leaks from earlier this year already raised hopes that the group would have some role in the current season of League of Legends. Details in a Wild Rift update, first spotted by SkinSpotlights , pointed to a potential “Firestarter” skin concept, as well as a new song registered on the ASCAP Repertory.
paragraphs.cn: 今年早些时候，数据挖掘泄露的信息就已让人期待，这个组合或许会以某种形式参与《英雄联盟》当前赛季。SkinSpotlights最先在《英雄联盟手游》的一次更新中发现了一些细节，指向一个可能名为「Firestarter」的皮肤概念，以及一首已在美国作曲家、作家和出版商协会（ASCAP）曲目库登记的新歌。

paragraphs.en: Other users have interpreted the purple smoke as a sign that K/DA is being added to Fortnite, which is currently using similarly colored imagery for its Fortnitemares event .
paragraphs.cn: 另一些用户则将紫色烟雾解读为K/DA即将加入《堡垒之夜》的信号，因为该游戏目前的梦魇活动（Fortnitemares）也采用了类似配色的视觉素材。

paragraphs.en: The question of K/DA’s return extends beyond Riot, as it also depends on the availability of the four singers associated with the group: Madison Beer, Soyeon, Miyeon, and Jaira Burns.
paragraphs.cn: K/DA能否回归，不只取决于Riot，还要看为组合献声的四位歌手是否有档期：Madison Beer、Soyeon、Miyeon和Jaira Burns。

paragraphs.en: Online fan accounts recently started circulating the rumor that Beer would be leaving the group. The singer herself was asked about her return to K/DA during her recent Locket tour, saying : "I would love to. It’s not really up to me, although I wish it was. There actually was a conversation a few years ago about doing something again, but I don’t know what happened to it.”
paragraphs.cn: 最近，网上的粉丝账号开始传播Beer将退出组合的传闻。Beer本人在近期的Locket巡演期间被问及是否会回归K/DA，她说：「我很愿意。但这其实不是我能决定的，虽然我希望能由我决定。几年前确实聊过再合作做点什么，但我不知道后来怎么样了。」

paragraphs.en: Riot has yet to confirm any rumors about a K/DA comeback, let alone who the group currently includes. The League of Legends World Championship tournament is currently being hosted across the United States, with the Grand Final scheduled for November 14. Given that K/DA made its debut at the Worlds tournament, there’s a possibility we'll hear more over the course of this year's event.
paragraphs.cn: Riot尚未证实任何有关K/DA回归的传闻，更不用说公布组合目前有哪些成员。《英雄联盟》全球总决赛目前正在美国多地举行，决赛定于11月14日举行。考虑到K/DA最初就是在全球总决赛上出道，我们或许会在今年赛事期间听到更多消息。
